about: Recording batch E3e of ADR 0012, the remaining recordings: FX-36's HTTP part and FX-37/a's early response through run-and-wait (gating F7b), the contested later cases (FX-49, Q-FX-11; FX-36, Q-FX-12; WR-16, Q-WR-15; WR-28, Q-WR-16), the probe catalogue rebuilt as executable fixtures (Q-OR-16, OR-V9) with the OR cases earlier batches left to E3e, codebase scripts in CommonJS and ESM (WR-47, WR-49, WR-50), FX-10/c, the pull round trip (CF-6/b, SY-6/c), and the cases recording batch E3a deferred here. No milestone of ADR 0012 but F7b needs E3e merged, so the batch has no gates; the later milestones that implement FX-49, WR-16 and WR-28 belong to L1. Each case is recorded on the CE oracle by a run of the fixtures below, or deferred with a milestone and a reason. TestRecordingBatches enforces it.

deferred.reason: its script, whose only import of ./helper is dynamic, cannot be deployed on the oracle: the dependency job takes the specifier for an npm package named "." and fails (bun install: Package "." with tag "latest" not found; oracle run 40798097155), so there is no deployed script to run; the later milestone that reproduces dynamic imports belongs to L1

source-derived; no E3e run records it: a dynamic import of a .ts workspace path, which the resolver plugin claims with no static rewrite trigger, so the deploy succeeds and the run fetches the script from the workspace; windmill-lite's build resolves workspace imports from the sync folder (C2a)

source-derived; no E3e run records it: dynamic builtin and package imports, the package locked at latest by the deploy's dependency job; windmill-lite consumes the folder's locks and generates none (ADR 0002, validation 5), and the later milestone that adds lock generation belongs to L1

on the oracle a //native codebase script's job never completed: canceled after 20 s, the run was still not complete after two minutes, in two sessions (oracle runs 40794872025, 40798097155), so no observation exists; windmill-lite follows the reference: C3n's step case (conformance/steps/bun/wr-50.yaml, WR-50/c and its control) and FU5's flow-level check (cmd/wltest TestNativeCodebaseFlowStep) run the //native ESM codebase script in the native runtime

when a push deploys a codebase script and which bundle then runs is the CLI's and the server's deploy pipeline, which needs a session that pushes, changes the tree and pushes again; windmill-lite builds each bundle from the folder it loads, so no milestone reproduces it
the deploy pipeline's digest, as for WR-49/c
the deploy pipeline's selection, as for WR-49/c
a direct script push, as for WR-49/c
a no-op snapshot request, as for WR-49/c

source-derived; no E3e run records it: a single-file upload's CRLF line breaks come from the CLI's form-data encoding, and the server and the worker keep them byte for byte; windmill-lite uploads nothing and builds each bundle from the folder it loads, with LF line breaks (ADR 0002, C2b's parity check), so no milestone of ADR 0012 reproduces them; a later one would belong to L1

source-derived; no E3e run records it: the arrays of other lengths, the string status code and the alias given twice, which decode to no metadata, are FX-36's HTTP part, which F7b, the HTTP adapter, implements

a script's own preprocessor runs only for a trigger (WR-11, later), which the harness does not fire, and no milestone of ADR 0012 implements script preprocessors; oracle/key-order run pre_keys records the flow-preprocessor variant instead
a restarted run: windmill-lite has no restart (ADR 0001 section 1), so the case is outside the equivalence contract and the harness drives no restart
its deployed half is E3a's (flows/je/branches, je36-d); the preview half is outside the contract, since windmill-lite has no preview mode (ADR 0001 section 1)
that the expression is accepted is E3a's (flows/je/loops, je-v1-a); telling a cap of two from none needs three workers, beyond the oracle's two (OR-5)

parts.part: the split CE deployment (MODE=server and MODE=worker), whose push fails with codebase is an EE feature
parts.reason: the oracle is CE in standalone mode only (OR-4); the standalone half is recorded

parts.part: a flow argument holding a NUL
parts.reason: the job API refuses such arguments before a job exists, which is a refused submission, not a run the harness can record

parts.part: the step's log line is kept
parts.reason: logs are not part of an observation (ADR 0001 section 7, Q-WA-9)

parts.part: the generic job endpoint answers WINDMILL_TOO_BIG
parts.reason: the harness reads payloads only from the dedicated endpoints (OR-V1), so the generic endpoint's substitute is in the raw capture, not the observation
the harness records the redirect without following it, and an observation keeps no response headers, so the catalogue's header is source-derived; F7b, the HTTP adapter, sends it
